list.name: repo
list.label: Repo
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT name FROM repos ORDER BY name

options.content:
## Engineering Intelligence — Executive View

DORA metrics + AI-era engineering signals. Filter by repo and toggle synthetic data above. Ask follow-up questions via the [devlake MCP](http://localhost:8811/mcp) in Claude — e.g. _"show team__architecture_code_gap and explain the top 3"_.

panels.title: How often do you ship? (deploys in window)
panels.description: Google DORA 2023: Elite ≥ 1/day, High ≥ 1/week, Medium ≥ 1/month, Low < 1/month. Band coloring uses the 90-day window.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS deploys FROM cicd_pipelines p JOIN cicd_pipeline_commits pc ON pc.pipeline_id = p.id JOIN repos r ON r.id = pc.repo_id WHERE p.type='DEPLOYMENT' AND p.result='SUCCESS' AND p.finished_date BETWEEN FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochFrom()) AND FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochTo()) AND r.name IN ($repo) AND ('$include_synthetic' = 'true' OR p.source IS NULL OR p.source != 'synthetic')

panels.title: How fast do you ship it? (mean lead time, hours)
panels.description: From first commit to successful deploy. Elite < 1h, High < 24h, Medium < 168h (1 week), Low ≥ 1 week.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, c.authored_date, p.finished_date)) / 60.0, 2) AS hours FROM cicd_pipelines p JOIN cicd_pipeline_commits pc ON pc.pipeline_id = p.id JOIN commits c ON c.sha = pc.commit_sha JOIN repos r ON r.id = pc.repo_id WHERE p.type='DEPLOYMENT' AND p.result='SUCCESS' AND p.finished_date BETWEEN FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochFrom()) AND FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochTo()) AND r.name IN ($repo) AND ('$include_synthetic' = 'true' OR p.source IS NULL OR p.source != 'synthetic')

panels.title: How often do deploys break prod? (CFR, %)
panels.description: Share of deploys followed by an incident within 24h. Elite < 5%, High < 10%, Medium < 15%, Low ≥ 15%.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issues i WHERE i.type='INCIDENT' AND i.created_date BETWEEN p.finished_date AND DATE_ADD(p.finished_date, INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AND ('$include_synthetic' = 'true' OR i.source IS NULL OR i.source != 'synthetic')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS cfr FROM cicd_pipelines p JOIN cicd_pipeline_commits pc ON pc.pipeline_id = p.id JOIN repos r ON r.id = pc.repo_id WHERE p.type='DEPLOYMENT' AND p.finished_date BETWEEN FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochFrom()) AND FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochTo()) AND r.name IN ($repo) AND ('$include_synthetic' = 'true' OR p.source IS NULL OR p.source != 'synthetic')

panels.title: How fast do you recover? (mean TTR, hours)
panels.description: Mean incident resolution time. Elite < 1h, High < 24h, Medium < 168h, Low ≥ 1 week.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(lead_time_minutes) / 60.0, 2) AS hours FROM issues WHERE type='INCIDENT' AND created_date BETWEEN FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochFrom()) AND FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochTo()) AND resolution_date IS NOT NULL AND ('$include_synthetic' = 'true' OR source IS NULL OR source != 'synthetic')

panels.title: Deploys per week
panels.description: Weekly deploy counts over the selected window.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE(FROM_DAYS(TO_DAYS(p.finished_date) - MOD(TO_DAYS(p.finished_date) - 2, 7))) AS time, COUNT(*) AS value FROM cicd_pipelines p JOIN cicd_pipeline_commits pc ON pc.pipeline_id = p.id JOIN repos r ON r.id = pc.repo_id WHERE p.type='DEPLOYMENT' AND p.finished_date BETWEEN FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochFrom()) AND FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochTo()) AND r.name IN ($repo) AND ('$include_synthetic' = 'true' OR p.source IS NULL OR p.source != 'synthetic') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: DORA band per repo
panels.description: Google DORA 2023 classification per repository, computed over the selected window.

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.name AS repo, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS deploys, ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, c.authored_date, p.finished_date)), 2) AS lead_time_h, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 90 AND AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, c.authored_date, p.finished_date)) < 1 THEN 'Elite' WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 13 AND AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, c.authored_date, p.finished_date)) < 24 THEN 'High' WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) >= 3 AND AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, c.authored_date, p.finished_date)) < 168 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS band FROM repos r LEFT JOIN cicd_pipeline_commits pc ON pc.repo_id = r.id LEFT JOIN cicd_pipelines p ON p.id = pc.pipeline_id AND p.type='DEPLOYMENT' AND p.result='SUCCESS' AND p.finished_date BETWEEN FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochFrom()) AND FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochTo()) AND ('$include_synthetic' = 'true' OR p.source IS NULL OR p.source != 'synthetic') LEFT JOIN commits c ON c.sha = pc.commit_sha WHERE r.name IN ($repo) GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY deploys DESC

options.content:
### AI-era signals

These three panels are the differentiators vs. a DORA-only view. Higher ACG = more AI plan-abandonment; top contributors by batch-commit count ≈ heaviest AI adopters; persona comparison shows how DORA differs by engineering style.

panels.title: Architecture-Code Gap (by engineer)
panels.description: PR iteration × post-merge churn proxy for Mark Nelson's AI-plan-abandonment metric. Higher = more mid-stream rework.

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.user_name AS engineer, ROUND(AVG(cnt.c), 2) AS acg_score FROM accounts a JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.author_id = a.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT pull_request_id, COUNT(*) AS c FROM pull_request_comments GROUP BY pull_request_id) cnt ON cnt.pull_request_id = pr.id WHERE pr.merged_date BETWEEN FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochFrom()) AND FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochTo()) AND ('$include_synthetic' = 'true' OR a.source IS NULL OR a.source != 'synthetic') GROUP BY a.user_name HAVING acg_score IS NOT NULL ORDER BY acg_score DESC LIMIT 12

panels.title: AI adoption spread (batch commits per engineer)
panels.description: Count of commits larger than 250 lines — a proxy for AI-generated batch changes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.user_name AS engineer, COUNT(*) AS batch_commits FROM commits c JOIN accounts a ON a.id = c.author_id WHERE c.authored_date BETWEEN FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochFrom()) AND FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochTo()) AND (c.additions + c.deletions) > 250 AND ('$include_synthetic' = 'true' OR c.source IS NULL OR c.source != 'synthetic') GROUP BY a.user_name ORDER BY batch_commits DESC LIMIT 12

panels.title: DORA comparison: AI power users vs Traditional
panels.description: Buckets engineers by mean diff size (high ≥ 300 LoC, mixed 120-300, low < 120) and reports cohort metrics.

targets.rawSql: WITH per_author AS (SELECT c.author_id, COUNT(*) AS commits, AVG(c.additions + c.deletions) AS mean_diff, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, pr.created_date, pr.merged_date)) AS cycle_hours FROM commits c LEFT JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.author_id = c.author_id AND pr.merged_date BETWEEN FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochFrom()) AND FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochTo()) WHERE c.authored_date BETWEEN FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochFrom()) AND FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochTo()) AND ('$include_synthetic' = 'true' OR c.source IS NULL OR c.source != 'synthetic') GROUP BY c.author_id) SELECT CASE WHEN mean_diff >= 300 THEN 'AI Power User' WHEN mean_diff >= 120 THEN 'AI Adopter' ELSE 'Traditional' END AS persona, COUNT(*) AS engineers, ROUND(AVG(commits), 0) AS avg_commits, ROUND(AVG(mean_diff), 0) AS avg_diff, ROUND(AVG(cycle_hours), 1) AS avg_cycle_h FROM per_author GROUP BY persona ORDER BY FIELD(persona, 'AI Power User', 'AI Adopter', 'Traditional')

panels.title: Recent incidents
panels.description: Incidents in the selected window, newest first.

targets.rawSql: SELECT i.title, i.severity, i.created_date AS opened, ROUND(i.lead_time_minutes / 60.0, 2) AS ttr_h, i.original_type AS archetype FROM issues i WHERE i.type='INCIDENT' AND i.created_date BETWEEN FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochFrom()) AND FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochTo()) AND ('$include_synthetic' = 'true' OR i.source IS NULL OR i.source != 'synthetic') ORDER BY i.created_date DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Top contributors
panels.description: Sorted by commit count over the selected window.

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.user_name AS engineer, COUNT(c.sha) AS commits, SUM(c.additions) AS lines_added, SUM(c.deletions) AS lines_removed FROM accounts a LEFT JOIN commits c ON c.author_id = a.id AND c.authored_date BETWEEN FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochFrom()) AND FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochTo()) WHERE ('$include_synthetic' = 'true' OR a.source IS NULL OR a.source != 'synthetic') GROUP BY a.user_name HAVING commits > 0 ORDER BY commits DESC LIMIT 20
